scope: Source and visual-asset paths deleted in commits reachable from the product baseline under src/ and site/, checked against the v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.2.0 release-tag trees.

generation.deletedPaths: Unique sorted paths from git log --diff-filter=D at the product baseline, limited to src/ and site/.
generation.releaseTagPresence: For every deleted path, test exact tree membership with git cat-file -e <tag>:<path> for each audited release tag.

result.disposition: Three third-party provider brand images were present in v1.2.0 and were deliberately removed from the 1.3.0 product baseline because their redistribution basis was not closed; Swob-owned neutral glyphs replace them. The other ten known deleted tracked paths in scope were absent from all three official release-tag snapshots. The v1.2.0 binary also carried an unintended untracked worktree copy; see artifact-inventory.json.
